title: Review request
description: One review of a branch, stored as review/<id>/request.json ON the branch under review. Review files live outside data/ and are invisible to the runtime, the loaders, and the narrative validator — they are validated separately (REV issues). A merged branch carries its reviews into the base branch with status "merged"; that is the archive, so review files are never moved or deleted.

base.description: Base branch the narrative diff is taken against. Ignored when shape is "state-review".

baseSha.description: Merge-base commit frozen at creation, refreshed on demand. Absent means resolve it live.

head.description: Branch under review — the branch this file lives on.

statusSha.description: The head commit the current status was recorded against. A verdict judges one state of the branch, not the branch forever: when head has moved past this sha the approval is stale and tools should say so rather than showing it as current.

statusBy.description: Git identity that recorded the current status.

statusAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the current status.

shape.description: scene-pass and arc-pass are diffed against base; state-review is a diff-less table read of the current draft.

reviewers.description: Free-form git identities ("Name <email>"). Parlance has no account system at this tier.
